From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap & Next Steps — Redwood + Polaris Tech

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Polaris Tech's needs. Quick recap from my side so we have alignment: 

- Primary use case: real-time summarization and intent routing for customer support chat (English + Spanish).
- Traffic profile: ~5–8k concurrent daily users; peak concurrency ~300 users; average session length ~120 tokens.
- Success criteria: sub-300ms tail latency for short replies, 95% cost reduction vs current baseline for batch tasks, and strong hallucination mitigation for product specs.
- Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and a SOC 2 report is required for procurement.

Suggested next steps: 
1) I can put together a scoped proof-of-concept (2–4 week) using a dedicated pool + KV prefix caching.
2) Neha (cc'd) can run a short Q&A on data residency and integration requirements if that helps internal alignment.
3) If this looks good, we can schedule a 30-min technical sync + commercial outline next week.

Attached: discovery_notes-20260410.pdf (notes from today's call) and polaris_sow_template.pdf (example SOW + pricing bands).

Would love a quick note on priorities/timing — are you aiming to evaluate vendors this quarter?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before we tee up the technical sync: 

On data residency: we need proof that logs and inference traces can be stored in our US-only region. Is Redwood able to guarantee region-based storage for logs and audit trails for the POC?

Latency: you mentioned tail latency targets — do you have benchmark numbers from a similar customer or a reference architecture that hits ~300ms tail for sub-256 token responses?

Pricing/SOW: procurement will want to understand the commitment levels for Dedicated vs Hosted on your pricing bands. I've looped Samantha (procurement) to help assess.

Finally, can you confirm SOC 2 scope and whether Redwood supports HSM-backed KMS?

If you can share short answers (or link to relevant docs), we can decide whether to proceed with the 2–4 week POC.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior Product Manager | Polaris Tech
